title: Analytics
description: Track revenue, orders, inventory, and cart activity.

help.title: About Analytics
help.overview: Analytics summarizes paid revenue, orders, inventory, and carts for this company. It is a read of those records. Nothing on this page creates an order, a product, or a stock change.

sections.title: What the period changes
sections.body: The period is 7 days, 30 days, 90 days, or 1 year. It does not apply to every card.
items: Revenue, order counts, tax, shipping, and top products follow the period.
The revenue chart is paid revenue and paid order count per bucket inside that period (daily for 7d/30d, weekly for 90d, monthly for 1y).
Trend badges compare the selected period to the previous window of the same length.
Inventory and cart cards are the current picture. Changing the period does not recompute them.

sections.title: Money and currency
sections.body: Figures are never summed across currencies.
items: Total revenue is paid orders in the period, net of refunds.
Tax and shipping are sums from those same paid orders.
Use the currency control when more than one currency had sales in the period.

sections.title: Orders, products, stock, and carts
sections.body: Breakdown charts and lists use the data already loaded for this company.
items: Order status counts every non-deleted order in the period, not only paid ones.
Product status is the current catalog, not period-scoped.
Top products rank by line revenue in the selected currency and period.
Abandoned carts are inactive for more than an hour; active carts were updated within the last hour.
Open Product orders, Products, or Inventories from a KPI when you need to act on it.

errorDescription: Something went wrong while fetching dashboard data.
noStatusData: No status counts for this period.
noTopProducts: No product sales for this period.
